description_en: Ignores the evaluation results of a specific rule for specified resources. You can also set an ignore expiration date for the rule. After the ignore period expires, the evaluation results of the rule for the resources are automatically restored
description_zh: 忽略某条规则对某些资源的评估结果。您还可以设置规则的忽略时间，当忽略到期后，自动恢复显示该规则对资源的检测结果
kebab_example: aliyun config ignore-evaluation-results --config-rule-id cr-7e72626622af00510000 --resources ResourceId=lb-hp3a3b4ztyfm2plgm0000 Region=cn-beijing ResourceType=ACS::SLB::LoadBalancer ResourceAccountId=1009318965420000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IgnoreEvaluationResults
